messages.subject: Dubai / GCC Executive Profile | Infrastructure, Energy, Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Hall,

I am introducing my profile for retained and confidential senior leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. DHR Global lists you among its Dubai consultants, and your executive-search work across industrial, infrastructure and energy leadership makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major gold-mining, infrastructure and energy-transition environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments. My strongest fit is where country leadership intersects with government relations, ESG, external affairs, strategic partnerships, natural resources, infrastructure, energy transition and complex regulated operations.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential DHR mandates in the region.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
